== Overview ==
{{spoiler|book=cradle-09-bloodline|Madra is the fundamental spiritual energy and raw power of the soul, serving as the essential material from which souls are constructed. It is physically centered in a core located just below the navel, where all lines of power connect. This energy can be cycled through the body to provide strength and vitality, while its absence leaves a person feeling physically weak and spiritually empty. Madra can exist in a pure state, which is highly effective for attacking or defending the [[spirit]] and is compatible with all other forms. However, [[pure madra]] lacks the ability to interact with the physical world and can weaken specialized energies when used to power [[constructs]], similar to diluting wine with [[water]]. Most madra is categorized into various "[[aspects]]" that allow it to imitate different natural phenomena, such as fire, earth, [[wind]], [[water]], force, [[blood]], and life. Some specialized paths even allow for more complex forms like [[dreams]] or toxins. This energy is used by [[sacred artists]] to activate [[scripts]], fuel [[constructs]]—such as puppets or flying tools—and manipulate the environment. When a powerful [[sacred artist]] dies, they may leave behind a [[Remnant]], which is a living force composed entirely of madra. Through the use of madra, practitioners can bend or break physical laws to achieve extraordinary feats.}}
